Procedure.title: Procedure
cells: TITLE: Procedure for manufacturing process & product audit

PURPOSE: To establish and define an internal audit system to determine to what extent the quality management system and planned arrangements for manufacturing processes & product measurement are effectively implemented and maintained
SCOPE:  This is applicable to all processes and product  covered by the quality management systems.
a) ISO/IATF 16949 Requirement element / sub element  No. 9.2, 9.2.1, 9.2.2, 9.2.2.1, 9.2.2.2, 9.2.2.3 & 9.2.2.4

* Coverage of all type of products normally once in Year for product audit
*  Coverage of all processes normally once in year  for manufacturing Process audit  and critical process twice in year 
* Coverage of all shifts during audits
* All audit plan will be made with shift
* Child Part as per MISP

* Any new process added
* Internal PPM
* Customer claim ( Delivery / warranty)
* MISP/ Drawing
* Approved audit plan of all processes .

* Auditor should qualify minimum required level
* Ensure independence of auditors &  Availabilty of auditor / auditee.
* Previous month customer claim data.
* Internal defect ratio
* All auditors should covered at least once in year
* Audit schedule copy to auditees / auditors / process owner

* Relevant documents & records under audit scope from auditee
* Audit check sheets 
* Audit schedule

* Product audit concern briefing to auditee/ process owner .
* Recording of all audit details both conformance and nonconformance in check sheet .
* Coverage of scope .
* Atleast one part should be audited during product audit
* In case of functional defect found during product audit, check the product and inform to customer, if required.
*In case of any abnormility observed deviation to be raised for using that product.
* All process parameter defined in control plan should be check during audit
* Audit report should be customer recommended format if required by customer

* Process audit reports
* Process audit observation reports 
* Product audit concerns
Check the effectiveness of process risk analysis (PFMEA), control plan and associated documents

Prepare audit summary sheet
* Categorize NCR (Major, Minor)
* Observation / action sheets for improvement points
Check all shifts are covered are not?
Major NC- if product quality deviated
Minor NC - Product quality not deviated but no control
NCR should be write within two working days
* Document related to concern / process audit report

* Countermeasure apprioriateness for the problem .
*Corrective action such that the problem should not repeat
* Corrective action plan within 7 days for major and 14 days for minor
*  Target date for  concern / observation closure .
* Corrective action implementation fully before follow up audit/ verification
* Follow up audit within 7 days after completion of actions
* Verification of actions taken for process audit
* Original copy of NCR audit report and observation to QA.
Review the audit check sheet once in year
* Revised annual audit plan of the process (If required )
No. of concerns in process / product audit
Product Audit frequency  is change once in 6 month to once in year.
Process reviewed. Changes are highlighted with Blue Italic Font.
